description.en: Leclercqia-inspired divided-leaf shoot, naturally seated leaf bases and a few prominent split leaves with elongated recurved central tips; far leaves simplified. Terrestrial teaching plant, same recovered deferred ID, no species-level leaf-count or microvein restoration.
description.zh: Leclercqia启发裂叶枝，叶基自然接茎，主要裂叶具较长回曲中央部，远侧叶简化。陆生教学植物，同一延后ID恢复，不作种级叶数或微细叶脉复原。
